pages.heading: Bald Eagle
pages.body: Wooded mountains and nearby fishing spots. Tame with Fish Oil; heal with fish and breed with rotten flesh. A Falconry Glove holds the eagle; punch while aiming at a target to

pages.heading: Bald Eagle (cont.)
pages.body: launch it. A Falconry Hood enables direct flight control. Sneak to stop controlling it; shears remove the hood.
